name: chartwright
description: Natural-language charts in your own process: an agentic loop inspects your data locally, a deterministic compiler emits chart-library options.
//: The published artifact is dist/, never src/: node refuses to strip types for files under node_modules (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING), so a src-only entry point is unimportable by a plain node process. `npm run build` produces dist/ with the source's .ts import specifiers rewritten to .js.
//publish: Publish target stated here rather than inherited from the machine's npmrc. A mirror such as registry.npmmirror.com is read-only and cannot accept a publish, so a developer whose default registry is a mirror would otherwise get ENEEDAUTH against a registry that was never going to work. This makes the target explicit and machine-independent.
